name: Chris Dave Magahis
title: Front-End Developer
summary: Front-end developer and designer with 20+ years of experience building user-centric, high-performing websites for e-commerce, agency, and consultancy clients across the Philippines, the UAE, and the US. Hand-codes semantic, responsive HTML/CSS and manages WordPress portfolios on WP Engine. Most recently designed and built a multi-agent AI development system that automates site analysis, design, WordPress builds, and QA — two decades of craft paired with modern AI engineering.

experience.description: Colorado digital-marketing agency serving startups to Fortune 100 — deep behavioral-health, legal, and healthcare expertise.
highlights: Manage the agency's portfolio of client WordPress sites end to end — maintenance, plugin/theme updates, backups, security, and uptime/performance monitoring on WP Engine.
Build, add, and update pages across client sites (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg block themes), keeping every change on-brand and content-accurate.
Support SEO, PPC, and content campaigns on the dev side — conversion landing pages, on-page SEO, and blog publishing through a staged dev-review → production workflow.

Designed and built the agency's project-management application as a custom WordPress plugin — Kanban boards, members, activity log, time tracking, and end-of-day reports on a 50-endpoint REST API (custom post types, PHP 8), served as a standalone full-page app that bypasses the theme and page builder entirely.
subHighlights: Designed and built "Devy," a multi-agent AI web-development system on Claude Code, orchestrating 8+ specialist agents (scraping, design, WordPress & React builds, QA) from intake to deployed build.
Engineered deterministic QA gates for AI-generated builds: pixel-diff visual parity (≥98% per breakpoint), scripted content-fidelity diffs, and computed-style verification of animations and effects.
Built an exact site-cloning pipeline that captures rendered HTML, CSS, assets, and motion from any platform (Squarespace, Elementor, Divi) and reproduces it as a native WordPress block theme.

Packaged the fleet as a versioned internal Claude Code plugin (private GitHub marketplace) so teammates run the same tooling with one command, integrated with production systems via MCP — Playwright, Google Ads/GA4, Drive, Figma, and Clarity.

Shipped AI agents for SEO and PPC operations — a 15-agent SEO analysis suite and an industry-agnostic Google Ads negative-keyword auditor — plus an AI-assisted blog-publishing workflow with a human-approval gate.

highlights: Project work done outside my full-time hours at Thunderbolt Group — building conversion-focused, mobile-responsive storefront templates in hand-coded HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap on the PinnacleCart eCommerce platform.

experience.description: All-in-one eCommerce platform (475+ features) for growth-focused SMBs.
highlights: Re-themed and upgraded merchant storefronts to the latest cart version — migrating live stores off legacy themes onto current, mobile-responsive templates without losing catalog, customers, or traffic.
Hand-coded semantic HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap to translate mockups into responsive, pixel-accurate pages; optimized CSS to cut file sizes and eliminate render-blocking resources.
Redesigned and built conversion-focused storefronts for merchants across industrial supply, e-commerce, and retail — from redesigns of existing stores to new builds from scratch.
Managed multiple WordPress sites on WP Engine — migrations, backup/restore drills, uptime, and performance — with minimal disruption to live traffic.
Managed the company website end to end — concept to final product — with cross-browser, multi-resolution testing; configured hosting, domains, and Google Workspace.

Designed corporate identity systems (logos, letterhead, business cards) and full marketing packages — brochures, banners, posters, print — plus original social-media graphics; administered SugarCRM and Apptivo.
Designed and developed a Shopify e-commerce store (jersey apparel); set up hosting, domains, and email, managed the product catalog, and linked the store to Facebook Shops.

earlierExperience.line: CMS websites on WordPress and Joomla, corporate branding, vtiger CRM administration, and daily email/SMS campaigns end to end.
Site performance and landing pages, SEO/SEM traffic growth, and email campaigns for a long-running Dubai travel agency.
Designed and deployed 15+ hand-coded hotel-booking websites; set the design guidelines, templates, and file-structure standards.
